justify_why_units_are_missing.justification: X-axes show continuous cytometry parameters (e.g., FSC-A, FSC-H, Viability, CD19, IgD) but no measurement units (such as arbitrary fluorescence units, channels, or scale notation) are indicated on the axis or in the figure caption.
Y-axes show continuous cytometry parameters (e.g., FSC-H, SSC-A, CD4, Fas, IgM) but no measurement units are indicated on the axis or in the figure caption.
X-axes show continuous flow-cytometry markers (e.g., CD19, IgD) without units or indication that values are in arbitrary fluorescence units or channel numbers; the caption does not define units.
Y-axes show continuous flow-cytometry markers (e.g., CD98, FSC-A) without units or scale definition on the axis or in the caption.
X-axes display continuous cytometry measurements (e.g., IgD, NP, CD138) but no units (such as AU or channel numbers) are given on the plots or in the caption.
Y-axes display continuous cytometry measurements (e.g., IgM, Fas, CD38) but lack any unit labeling or unit definition in the caption.
X-axes show continuous marker intensities (e.g., CD44, PD-L2) typical of flow-cytometry but do not indicate units (no AU, channel numbers, or scale info) on the axes or in the caption.
Y-axes show continuous marker intensities (e.g., CD62L, CD80) without any unit annotation on the plot or definition in the caption.
X-axes depict continuous cytometry marker intensities (e.g., CD44, PD-L2) but lack unit labels on the axes and the caption provides no unit definition.
Y-axes depict continuous cytometry marker intensities (e.g., CD62L, CD80) with no unit annotation on the figure and no units defined in the caption.
